entities.name: PMID:25070024
observations: In patient-derived esophageal adenocarcinoma lines PT6216 and LN6216c, EGFR FISH showed homogeneously high polysomy; both lines were described as highly sensitive/responsive to gefitinib in proliferation and vitality assays.
The available abstract does not report IC50 values, dose range, detailed control-line results, or enough EGFR mutation data to establish polysomy as the sole determinant of response.

entities.name: PT6216
observations: Patient-derived primary esophageal adenocarcinoma cell line with homogeneously high EGFR polysomy by FISH; highly sensitive/responsive to gefitinib in reported proliferation and vitality assays.

entities.name: LN6216c
observations: Patient-derived lymph-node metastatic esophageal adenocarcinoma cell line with homogeneously high EGFR polysomy by FISH; highly sensitive/responsive to gefitinib in reported proliferation and vitality assays.

entities.name: Gefitinib
observations: Gefitinib produced a qualitative strong response in the high-EGFR-polysomy esophageal adenocarcinoma lines PT6216 and LN6216c; quantitative sensitivity values were not available in the retrieved abstract.
Across eight esophageal carcinoma lines in a separate study, gefitinib caused dose-dependent growth inhibition with IC50 values of 5.7–36.9 micromolar, without polysomy-specific stratification.

entities.name: Polysomy prediction limited
observations: High EGFR polysomy was associated with gefitinib sensitivity in two related esophageal adenocarcinoma lines, but available evidence does not validate high polysomy alone as a predictive biomarker because accompanying EGFR expression, mutation, and detailed comparator data are incomplete.
